description: Stable Image Services, a comprehensive suite of thirteen specialized image editing tools from Stability AI designed to accelerate professional creative workflows.  Stable Image Services enables granular control over image editing with a range of tools designed to work with your creative process, allowing you to take a single concept from ideation to finished product with precision and flexibility. The Stable Image Creative Upscale service takes images between 64x64 and 1 megapixel and upscales them all the way to 4K resolution. Put more generally, it can upscale images ~20-40x times while preserving, and often enhancing, quality. Creative Upscale works best on highly degraded images and is not for photos of 1mp or above as it performs heavy reimagining (controlled by creativity scale).
